name: zp2sos
comment: Sig sos=zp2sos(z,p,k): zero/pole/gain -> second-order sections. Real-pole case (2 zeros, 4 poles) validated via the order/pairing-invariant sos2tf round-trip: bb=[0 0 2 -0.4 -0.3], aa(end)=-0.0048, sum(aa)=0.4032 (surplus zeros at the ORIGIN -> leading bb(1)=0, bb(3)=2). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: section ORDER now matches MATLAB's default 'up' (ASCENDING pole radius). Complex-conjugate poles pc -> row1 (radius 0.36) c15=-0.4 c16=0.13, row2 (radius 0.707) c25=-1 c26=0.5; numkit previously reversed this. NOTE: pairing of purely REAL poles still uses numkit's grouping (MATLAB zpkpair differs); the product TF is unaffected. Matches MATLAB R2025b for complex-pole filters.
